build.summary:
The package was already built when I started, so I reviewed it rather than rewriting it. The lead's note said the run-1 attempt failed before doing any work, but that is not what is on disk. The snapshot folder and .started are from 12:31. All 12 listed files were edited or created between 12:43 and 13:04, along with a new test file, src/ui/sections/PhysiologyLab.test.ts.

I checked every file against the design in lab-build-plan.json, the lab request pm-physiology#1 and the lesson pm-physiology-setup text, and found the design fully in place:
- **pwSession.ts** is a pure reducer over the pressure-wire state. It covers zero, connections, introduce, introducer out, flushing the guide and the aortic line, sensor and advance, equalise (valid only within the EQUALISE_MIN/MAX_MM window), guide change, wire reshape, a new wire, hyperaemia, measurement, pullback, drift check, thermodilution, stent and decide. Drift comes from MP_DRIFT_SD and each preset's fault from the lesson's troubleshooting table.
- **pressureWire.ts** changes are additive: SENSOR_FROM_TIP_MM, EQUALISE_MIN_MM, equaliseValidAt, and optional channel errors on measure(). Default behaviour is unchanged and tested.
- **PhysiologyLab.tsx** runs a PhysiologyRig: a PatientEngine whose profile is fitted to the preset's mean aortic pressure, on a 50 Hz setInterval model clock. Each step feeds the engine's mean aortic pressure and heart rate into the case. Air and contrast in the line are applied to the engine's transducer, and the guide is a tip input. The lab registers the window.__lab.physiology hook (context, tips, state, step, dispatch), launches through useLabLaunch, logs the run through useLabRun, and shows the case teaching text only after the decision. The old constants (PRE_EQUALISE_OFFSET, the 3.5 mmHg offset, the private drift ramp) are gone.
- **The UI** is split into SetupPanel, MeasurePanel, TraceView, PullbackPlot and VesselStrip. PullbackPlot and VesselStrip take plain props so the PCI lab's console can reuse them.
- **physiologyTips.ts** exports physiologyTipContext, a step-aware tip ranking and `raises`.
- **core.launch.ts** lists all 15 presets (the 7 teaching cases and the 8 fault presets) under pm-physiology-setup.

I made one change: source comments for the IV adenosine dose (140 µg/kg/min, from lesson pm-physiology-indices) in pwSession.ts and MeasurePanel.tsx. All five test files, 55 tests, pass, as do the content, tips, lab plumbing, practice index and reachability tests, and the typecheck.

build.notes:
1. **The earlier attempt did real work.** The lead's note said the run-1 attempt failed before doing any work. On disk, though, datasets/tmp/wp-snapshots/physiology-engine-unify-and-setup/ (snapshot of PhysiologyLab.tsx and pressureWire.ts, plus .started) dates from 12:31. All 12 listed files and src/ui/sections/PhysiologyLab.test.ts were then written between 12:43 and 13:04. I did not overwrite the snapshot or re-touch .started. Overwriting would have replaced the true pre-package versions with the edited ones, leaving reviewers no baseline to diff against. Only those two files existed before the package; the other ten were created by it. In that window, other files changed (src/simulation/diagnosticScenarios/*, procedure.ts, session/multiSite.tips.test.ts, session/scenarios/crossover*, caseGenerator.ts, prebrief.ts, Simulator.tsx, labSession.ts). They belong to the packages running at the same time (diag-scenario-registry, access-multi-site, proc-*), not to this one.

2. **One deliberate departure from the design.** The tipIntegration text lists 'air' among the fault events. Air in the aortic line is instead reported as pressure 'damped' plus the event pressure-damped, not as 'air'. I checked what 'air' would bring up at phase physiology: pci-air-first-moves and pci-air-find-source, which are coronary air-embolism tips and would be wrong advice for a bubble in the transducer line. The acceptance criterion (overdamped verdict, pressure 'damped') is met. The comment in physiologyTips.ts explains this and a test asserts it.

3. **total-occlusion for CTO donor presets.** It reaches the context through launch events and preset events. No CTO-donor preset exists yet; physiology-decision-and-subsets adds those cases.

4. **My only edits** were two source comments for the IV adenosine 140 µg/kg/min (module text 14-physiology.ts, lesson pm-physiology-indices: 'Intravenous: 140–180 µg/kg/min'). The fault causes and remedies, the 3 cm sensor position and the 0.98–1.02 drift window were checked against the lesson pm-physiology-setup text and its troubleshooting table.

5. **UI rules.** Generic names are used in the UI chrome ('Change to a better-fitting guide'). 'EBU 4.0' appears only in a case brief, as the lesson itself uses it. Trace colours are the original monitor colours, and all text is at least 12 px. Why a reading is wrong (log aids, the hyperaemia percentage) shows only when labScreens(policy).attendingDrawer is on. The answer and the set-up checklist appear only after the decision.

review.verdict: Changes requested. The acceptance criteria hold. All 5 package test files pass (55 tests), `npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit` is clean, and I checked the browser criterion myself on localhost:5173: `__lab.physiology.step(30)` moved session t from 4.98 to 34.98 and `context()` returned `{lab:'pci', phase:'physiology', pressure:'damped', events:['pressure-damped'], vessel:'LAD'}`. The pressureWire.ts changes are additive and its defaults are unchanged. physiology.ts was not touched, and the console matches `physiology.indices` exactly at equal MAP. The 12 listed files plus the new `src/ui/sections/PhysiologyLab.test.ts` are the only files tied to this package. The other files under src/ that are newer than `.started` were changed by concurrent packages: `src/content/lab/tips.ts` and `waiting.ts` were edited at 18:59, matching the repair-launch-fixture-and-tip-ties snapshot, and access, diag and proc own the rest. Two major problems remain. First, adenosine and nitrate never reach the PatientEngine, so the engine-driven blood pressure, heart rate and rhythm do not respond to the drugs, and `raises` claims patient events this lab cannot produce. Second, after the decision the lab disables every control, so the 'Stent the X lesion, then re-measure' path is a dead end. That is a regression from the old lab and breaks the tandem case. The minor issues are a false tick in the set-up panel, the validity of pullback records, uncapped drift, wrong-context tips at the start of a study, per-tick cost, and unlabelled constants.

findings.where: src/ui/sections/PhysiologyLab.tsx PhysiologyRig.dispatch (lines 123-134); src/ui/lab/physiologyTips.ts PHYSIOLOGY_PATIENT_EVENTS / raises (lines 55, 89-93); src/simulation/pci/pwSession.ts MP_IV_RAMP_S (line 70)
findings.problem: The design says aortic pressure, heart rate and rhythm come from the PatientEngine, but the 'hyperaemia' (IV/IC adenosine) and 'gtn' actions only change the reducer, never the engine. The engine does support adenosine: pharmacology.ts has sourced ADENOSINE constants and AV-block logic at engine.ts:682-699 and 1244-1258. So during IV adenosine the aortic pressure does not fall, the heart rate does not change and no AV block or bradycardia ever occurs. Lesson pm-physiology-indices (14-physiology.ts:438, 1294) teaches the fall in systolic pressure as the sign that hyperaemia is real. As a result, `raises` declares bradycardia, av-block, vf, vt, atrial-fibrillation, st-elevation, chest-pain and desaturation, which this lab (a stable SA profile in sinus rhythm, no drug given) cannot produce. The reachability gain (483 -> 448) is therefore partly false. The only test for these events (physiologyTips.test.ts 'patient events from the engine's vitals') feeds hand-made vitals `{hr:38, av:3}` instead of driving the rig. Separately, the MP_IV_RAMP_S comment says the real onset is 'about 1-2 min', but the lesson says 60-90 s.
findings.fix: In PhysiologyRig.dispatch, mirror the drug actions onto the engine. On {type:'hyperaemia',mode:'iv'}, call this.engine.startInfusion({drug:'adenosine', rate:140, ...}) with the InfusionOrder shape from pharmacology.ts (140 µg/kg/min, lesson pm-physiology-indices). On mode 'ic', call this.engine.giveDrug('adenosine', dose, 'ic', {side}), using the lesson's IC doses (RCA 50-100 µg, left 200 µg, 14-physiology.ts:410; use guideTip(s).side). On 'none', stop the infusion. On 'gtn', give the formulary nitrate with a dose cited from the module text or the formulary. Optionally take session hyperaemia from the engine's adenosine effect level instead of MP_IV_RAMP_S. Then cut PHYSIOLOGY_PATIENT_EVENTS to the events a rig test actually produces, for example: start IV adenosine on a fixed seed, step(40), assert that MAP fell and that context().events can include bradycardia or av-block (choose a seed that draws the block). Change the MP_IV_RAMP_S comment to 'time-compressed from 60-90 s (lesson pm-physiology-indices)'.

findings.problem: After the decision, SetupPanel, MeasurePanel, ThermoPanel and VesselStrip all get disabled={decided}. The debrief still offers 'Stent the {id} lesion, then re-measure' for multi-lesion presets (tandem, whose decision is 'treat-first-then-remeasure'). Clicking it clears s.records, but the learner can no longer move the sensor, give adenosine or measure. The old lab kept its measurement controls enabled after the decision. The re-measure teaching of the tandem case is now unreachable, and 'Your measurements' simply empties.
findings.fix: Add `const locked = decided && s.treated.length === 0;` and pass disabled={locked} to SetupPanel, MeasurePanel and ThermoPanel, and disabled={locked || !!s.pullback?.active} to VesselStrip. Alternatively, leave the measure panels and strip enabled after the decision, as the old lab did. The run is already logged once at the decision, so later measurements do not affect scoring.

findings.where: src/simulation/pci/pwSession.ts pwSessionReducer (lines 641-645) and the 'introduce' case (700-714); src/ui/physiology/SetupPanel.tsx line 48
findings.problem: `did` records an action whenever the reducer returns a new object, and log() always does, so refused actions are ticked too. Example: on a packet preset, clicking 'Remove the introducer' before introducing the wire logs 'no wire in the guide' but adds 'remove-introducer' to did. 'Introduce' then puts the introducer in (introducer:true) without clearing that tick. The panel shows '✓ Remove the introducer' while the introducer is still in the valve, and an equalisation then absorbs the leak.
findings.fix: In reduce() 'introduce', set `did: s.did.filter(t => t !== 'remove-introducer')`. In pwSessionReducer, skip adding to did when the action was refused: return a flag from reduce, or check `n.log[0] !== s.log[0] && n.log[0].bad`, and mark the refusals 'no wire in the guide' and 'not in the valve' as bad. Add a pwSession test: remove-introducer, then introduce, then expect did not to contain 'remove-introducer'.

findings.where: src/simulation/pci/pwSession.ts tick pullback record (line 663) and readingProblems (line 587)
findings.problem: Every completed pullback is recorded with valid:true whatever its problems, and readingProblems(n,'pullback') always contains 'the sensor is not distal to every lesion', because the pullback ends at the guide tip. Records with valid:true and a non-empty problems list contradict each other, and the debrief or any consumer cannot trust either field.
findings.fix: In readingProblems, skip the distal check for kind 'pullback' as well as 'drift-check': `if (kind !== 'drift-check' && kind !== 'pullback' && ...)`. In the tick, set `valid: problems.length === 0` using the computed problems.

findings.problem: The old lab capped the 'drift' case's drift at c.drift (min(c.drift, elapsed/45 * c.drift)). The new driftPerS = c.drift/45 has no ceiling, so after 3 minutes of lab time the offset reaches about 16 mmHg. That changes the behaviour of a teaching case this package was meant to keep.
findings.fix: Add an optional `driftCapMmHg` to PhysiologyPreset (set to c.drift for that case). In the tick, clamp the drift accumulated since the last equalisation: store `eqOffset` at equalise and clamp `wire.offset - eqOffset` to ±cap. Alternatively, state the change in the case text and docs.

findings.problem: Packet presets start with contrast in the guide, so ctx.pressure is 'damped' from t=0. In the browser, lad-intermediate (a mid-LAD lesion) put pci-phys-damped-guide and pci-phys-ostial-disengage ('Aorto-ostial lesion: equalise in the aorta, measure disengaged') at the top of the panel before any action. That is the wrong advice for a non-ostial lesion when the damping comes from contrast or air in the line.
findings.fix: Outside this package's files: give pci-phys-ostial-disengage (14-physiology.ts:2312) a condition that only an ostial or obstructing-guide study raises, for example `requires:['ostial-lesion']`, and have physiologyTipContext raise it when sessionCase(s).guideObstructs. Report this to the tips owner. Inside the package: in rankPhysiologyTips, rank tips from lesson pm-physiology-subsets below the step's lessons unless sessionCase(session).guideObstructs.

findings.problem: Every 20 ms tick calls guidePressure. For guide-obstructing presets that means 120 reading() calls, each JSON.stringify-ing the case in physiology.ts caseKey: about 6,000 stringify calls per second all the time. pdAt runs for every drawn trace sample in the rAF path and builds a new measuredCase object (spread plus lesion filter) on every call.
findings.fix: Memoise guidePressure's classifyTip result in a small Map keyed on `${c.id}|${s.map}|${Math.round(hyperaemia(s)*50)}|${s.guideEngaged}|${s.treated.join()}`, as SHAPE_CACHE already does. Cache measuredCase per session object with a WeakMap<PwSessionState, CoronaryCase>, so pdAt reuses one object per state.

findings.where: src/simulation/pci/pwSession.ts lines 587 (0.15), 677-678 (normal(rng,0,3)), 798 (h > 0.5), 814 (sensorX < 0.6); src/ui/lab/physiologyTips.ts line 101 (sensorMm <= 5); new MP_* constants overall
findings.problem: Several magnitudes have no label: the 'distal to every lesion' margin, the 3 mmHg SD of the post-zero offset, the hyperaemia threshold for an FFR pullback, the distal fraction for thermodilution and the step threshold. The project rule says every number is either cited from the module text or labelled MODEL PARAMETER in docs/realism/facts. The new MP_* constants are labelled in code only.
findings.fix: Lift each value into a named `MP_...` constant with a 'MODEL PARAMETER' doc comment next to the existing ones, and reuse MP_* where one already fits (EQUALISE_MAX_MM for the 5 mm). Ask the docs owner to add the new MP_* entries to docs/realism/facts; that file is outside this package.

fix.notes:
I checked all 8 findings against the code and the plan, applied all of them and rejected none. Findings 6 and 8 also need changes outside this package's files (listed at the end). All edits are in the package's files and its test files.

1. **Drugs now reach the patient engine (major)**, in PhysiologyLab.tsx through the new PhysiologyRig.applyDrug:
   - IV adenosine starts an infusion on the engine at ADENOSINE.ivStandardUgKgMin (140 µg/kg/min) through a central line. Stopping adenosine, or switching away from IV, stops the infusion.
   - An IC bolus uses the lesson's dose for the guide's side (14-physiology.ts:410): left 200 µg; right 100 µg, the "no more than 100 µg" RCA ceiling. These are in the new constant IC_ADENOSINE_UG.
   - GTN is given IC at 200 µg (IC_GTN_UG; 14-physiology.ts:1117 "100–200 µg" and :1284 "at most 200 µg").
   - Session hyperaemia still uses the time-compressed MP_IV_RAMP_S. Driving it from the engine would not work: the engine's IV effect level tops out at about 0.91, below MP_MAX_H (0.95), so FFR would never count as maximal. The engine runs its own sourced onset for the pressure, rate and rhythm response. The MP_IV_RAMP_S comment now says "time-compressed from 60-90 s (lesson pm-physiology-indices)".
   - Over 150 seeds, the rig produced hypotension, bradycardia and av-block, and nothing else. PHYSIOLOGY_PATIENT_EVENTS is cut to those three. Reachability is now 483 -> 452 (it was 448).
   - New rig tests: on seed "b13", IV adenosine lowers MAP by more than 4 mmHg and raises all three events, and the block clears after the infusion stops. On seed "s3", MAP falls with no block. Spies check the doses and calls sent to the engine. The hand-made-vitals test stays as a check of the context function only.
2. **Controls after the decision (major).** Added `locked = decided && s.treated.length === 0`. SetupPanel, MeasurePanel and ThermoPanel take `locked`, and VesselStrip takes `locked || pullback.active`. The tandem re-measurement works again.
3. **Refused actions were ticked as done (minor).**
   - pwSessionReducer no longer adds an action to `did` when its new log entry is `bad`. An out-of-range drift check is the one exception, because the check was done.
   - The two remove-introducer refusals are now marked `bad`.
   - 'introduce' clears the 'remove-introducer' tick.
   - Covered by a new test.
4. **Pullback records (minor).** readingProblems no longer applies the distal check to 'pullback'. The record's `valid` now equals `problems.length === 0`. Tests cover a clean pullback (valid) and one with contrast still in the guide (invalid).
5. **Drift cap (minor).** New optional PhysiologyPreset.driftCapMmHg, set to |c.drift| on the drift case. In the tick, the first wire's drift since its last equalisation is clamped to the cap, using sinceEqualiseS, so no new state was needed. This restores the old lab's min(c.drift, elapsed/45 × c.drift). A new wire draws its own drift with no cap. Covered by a test.
6. **Ostial tip on a non-ostial case (minor), package part.** In rankPhysiologyTips, a pm-physiology-subsets tip that matches on a damped pressure now ranks last unless sessionCase(s).guideObstructs. The other subsets tips lose their step bonus in that case. Tested on lad-intermediate (the tip is out of the top 5, and the damped-guide tip stays in) and on guide-wedge (the tip is still in the top 5).
7. **Performance (minor).**
   - guidePressure's classifyTip loop for an obstructing guide is memoised in GUIDE_CACHE. The key is case id, MAP, hyperaemia rounded to 1/50 and the treated lesions, and the loop computes with that rounded hyperaemia so the cached result does not depend on call order.
   - sessionCase and measuredCase are cached per state in WeakMaps, so pdAt reuses one case object per state.
   - physiology.ts still JSON.stringifies the case inside reading(); that file is outside this package.
8. **Unlabelled numbers (minor).**
   - New MODEL PARAMETER constants in pwSession.ts: MP_DISTAL_MARGIN (0.15), MP_PULLBACK_FFR_H (0.5) and MP_THERMO_DISTAL_X (0.6).
   - The post-zero offset SD (3 mmHg) is now MP_ZERO_OFFSET_SD_MMHG in pressureWire.ts. initialPressureWire uses it with the same value, so default behaviour does not change.
   - physiologyTips' step threshold of 5 mm now uses EQUALISE_MAX_MM.

**Out of scope (for other owners):**
- **Tips owner:** give pci-phys-ostial-disengage (14-physiology.ts:2312) a condition that only an ostial or obstructing-guide study raises, for example `requires:['ostial-lesion']`, so it stops matching on any damped trace.
- **Docs owner:** add docs/realism/facts entries for MP_ZERO_OFFSET_SD_MMHG, MP_DISTAL_MARGIN, MP_PULLBACK_FFR_H, MP_THERMO_DISTAL_X, PhysiologyPreset.driftCapMmHg, and the earlier MP_* constants of pwSession.ts and PhysiologyLab.tsx.
- **physiology.ts owner (optional):** caseKey stringifies on every reading(); an identity cache there would remove most of the remaining per-sample cost.

fix2.notes:
I checked all three findings against the code and applied each one.

1. **Slider labels running into each other (VesselStrip.tsx).** Confirmed: the label row was a flex justify-between row with no gap. It is now a three-column grid with a gap (`grid grid-cols-3 gap-3`). The middle label is centred and the last one is right-aligned.

2. **Patient starting bradycardic before any adenosine (PhysiologyLab.tsx).** Confirmed, though the cause is slightly different from the finding. generatePatient never draws a resting rate below 50 bpm (patient.ts clamps it to 50-112). The bradycardia threshold is "below 50" (PATIENT_EVENT_THRESHOLDS.bradycardiaHr). So a seed at the floor, 50-51 bpm, shows rates under 50 from normal beat-to-beat variation. That raised the event at rest and pushed the "Heart block after adenosine" tip up the panel.
   - **Fix:** a new exported constant, MP_MIN_REST_HR, set to the threshold plus 5 and labelled MODEL PARAMETER with its source. physiologyProfile now sets the baseline rate to at least this value (`hr: Math.max(p0.baseline.hr, MP_MIN_REST_HR)`).
   - **Why this fix rather than the alternative:** I did not filter the event in physiologyTipContext. With the clamp, adenosine-induced bradycardia and AV block are still reported, and the existing adenosine test still reaches every declared patient event.
   - **New test (PhysiologyLab.test.ts):** it finds seeds at the generator's floor for fault-ebu-lcx, the preset named in the finding. It checks that the profile rate is at least MP_MIN_REST_HR and that 20 s of the rig at rest never raises bradycardia.

3. **"Will not equalise" tip ranked first after a good equalisation (physiologyTips.ts).** Confirmed.
   - **Fix:** a new exported helper, equalisedCleanly(s), true when the current wire was equalised at the guide tip with matching waveforms (`!!s.eq && s.eq.atTip && !s.eq.mismatch && s.eq.wireId === s.wireId`). When it is true, rankPhysiologyTips moves pci-phys-equalise-fail to the end of the panel, the same way it already demotes the ostial tips. The tip is not removed, and it comes back for a new wire that has not been equalised.
   - **New test (physiologyTips.test.ts):** it equalises cleanly on lad-intermediate and checks that the tip is out of the top 5 and last in the full ranking. It also checks that equalisedCleanly is false again after a new wire.
